claims_for_research.claim: A static-camera regeneration changes the generated sample as well as camera instructions; multiple controlled replicates are needed rather than attributing causality to one improved clip. This methodological caution occurs in unchanged documentation and is repeated in the report.
Random variation is not itself proof of formal causal confounding.

Park et al., Evaluating Generative AI in the Lab, v2 dated 2026-01-28, recommend documenting prompts, outputs, latency and contextual variables to distinguish design effects from stochastic model variation.
